correctness.evidence: scripts/src/lib/verification.ts:76 changed VERIFY_COMMAND_FORBIDDEN from /[&|;`<>\n]|\$\(/ to /[&|;`<>\n$]/ (mirrored in built scripts/lib/verification.js:40). Probed isValidVerifyCommand directly via `node -e` against the built JS: 'npm test $FLAGS', 'npm test ${FLAGS}', 'npm test $(whoami)', 'npm test $((1+1))', 'npm test $0', 'npm test $@', 'npm test $*', 'npm test $!', 'npm test $?', 'npm test $$' all -> false (rejected); plain commands like 'npm test', 'npm run test:unit', 'echo hi' -> true (still accepted).
